text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan managed to deliver
splendid results in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years"—

And so, one day while still basking in the afterglow
of that major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Amazing, everywhere is so sparkly♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
True to its name, the '#InstaSweetsExhibition'
has so many adorable treats~♪

Brought along by Curren Chan,
I found myself at a department store basement event.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Now then, where should I check out first~—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
C-Could you be...
"Cute Curren Chan"!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's cute Curren Chan♪

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Hyek, she's so cute in person...!
N-No, that's not it.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Waah, really?
Then maybe I'll take a photo♪

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh, I'm so thrilled
that the one and only Curren-san would make a post about me!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"So, could you also be...
perhaps an Umastagrammer?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, this person is Curren's Trai...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...That's it♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: A ve~ry precious person to Curren♪

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
T-That tone of voice...!
Don't tell me...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, if you take a look at Curren's post,
you'll understand, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everywhere I look... is filled with memories
of big brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everywhere I look... is filled with memories
of big sister.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Right? Curren's precious...
Big Brother♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Right? Curren's precious...
Big Sister♪
